summary: The check you send back: {donor} sends money you did not ask for, and keeping it would make you look like theirs.
realLife: He lost three races for governor of Wisconsin before winning the 1957 special Senate election. Late in his career he returned unsolicited donations and spent under $200 to win reelection, mostly on filing paperwork.
gates: A gift on record from someone with business before the office.
choices: send it back with a note
send it back and say so in public
make a rule to take no money at all

branches.then: After several losses you run on handshakes and almost no money, and the papers notice.
In later races you spend almost nothing beyond the filing, and that becomes who you are.
